title: cyperus longus var. pallescens
intro: Cyperus longus var. pallescens, commonly known as the Pale Galingale, is a variant of the Cyperus longus plant, a type of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus longus var. pallescens include analgesic, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help relieve pain, reduce muscle spasms, and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene and diterpene compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
